blockingFindings.title: No-flow layout is not actually no-flow
blockingFindings.rationale: R7 explicitly requires spec-local tests to construct a no-flow repository layout; the current artifact marks R7 covered, but the test does not exercise that layout.
blockingFindings.issue: The `no-flow` matrix case passes `activeCount: 0`, but `makeLayout` still creates one `specs/foreign-1/flow.json`, one `.senti/agent-cache/...` file, and one context because the loop uses `Math.max(activeCount, 1)`. With `withFlowManager: false`, this covers a repository with no flow manager but still seeded flow artifacts, not a no-flow repository layout.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Adjust the fixture or add a separate R7 case that constructs a repository layout with no active flow artifacts/contexts and verifies standalone calls do not create or mutate flow/cache state.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R7 explicitly requires spec-local tests to construct a no-flow repository layout; the current artifact marks R7 covered, but the test does not exercise that layout.

blockingFindings.title: R4 does not assert core-bound attribution cannot be overridden
blockingFindings.rationale: R4 specifically requires the plugin cannot override the core-bound attribution mode; the current R4 coverage omits that contract and the coverage artifact incorrectly marks it covered.
blockingFindings.issue: The R4 test records delegated `resolve` and `call` options but only asserts command namespacing plus provider/profile precedence. It never asserts that delegated options include the core-bound no-flow attribution after plugin/user options, so an implementation could pass this test while allowing plugin-supplied `flowAttribution` to override the core binding.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add an assertion in the R4 delegate test that both delegated `resolve` and `call` receive the enforced no-flow attribution even when caller options attempt to supply a different attribution mode.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R4 specifically requires the plugin cannot override the core-bound attribution mode; the current R4 coverage omits that contract and the coverage artifact incorrectly marks it covered.
